text:
alex: FYI — I want to change how console patches runtime config for feature gates. Plan: add `targetingRules` + per-customer quota caps. Need safe rollout strategy.

maria: can you sketch the API shape? REST patch or a single transactional PUT? :thinking_face: 

alex: lean toward transactional PATCH to avoid partial updates. Example flag object:

```
{
  "key": "enable_v2_routing",
  "enabled": true,
  "targetingRules": [
    {"type":"percent","value":3},
    {"type":"whitelist","users":["team-alpha"]}
  ],
  "quota": {"qps": 50, "burst": 200}
}
```

sam: how will the rollout interact with routing policies? if 3% hits dedicated pools we might spike costs.

alex: good point — propose routing tag in the flag so we can scope by capacity tier: `route_scope: ["hosted","dedicated-opt"]`.

jin: telemetry PLEASE include `flag_key`, `rollout_pct`, `route_scope`, and `bucket_id` in traces. We need automatic regression alerts if error-rate delta > 0.5% or latency P95 +50ms.

maria: add a kill-switch and a console confirmation step for >10% rollouts. Also require schema validation on the server and a dry-run mode that only emits telemetry.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed for schema v3. runbook: /runbooks/featflag-rollout.md :white_check_mark:

ops-sentinel: suggest auto-fallback policy: if errors spike, reduce `rollout_pct` to 0 and route traffic to previous stable model. Implement a 60s cool-down window before reattempt.

sam: for the SDK behavior, make sure cached flag TTLs are invalidated on config-change event. otherwise clients can be stuck for minutes.

alex: agreed. We'll emit a config-change webhook + SSE for private deployments. For hosted, push via pubs/sub.

maria: doc + console UX note: when admins set a percent, show estimated qps impact and cost delta. small tooltip: "3% ≈ 4qps across EU-hosted" :money_with_wings: 

jin: I'll add a metric deck: flag_rollout.{flag_key}.p95, error_rate, cost_estimate. Alert thresholds as discussed.

alex: timeline: ship schema + validation to canary tomorrow, dry-run telemetry same-day, 3% rollout on Friday if green. tagging @sam and @jin for follow-ups.

sam: ack. I'll add unit tests for patch atomicity and a quick e2e to validate routing tag works in sim env. :white_check_mark:

maria: sounds good. will prepare console confirmation modal copy.

alex: thanks all. tagging this thread as the rollout plan. :thumbsup:
